principles: Audit claims against executable CLI behavior, not prose alone.
Keep command defaults and lifecycle semantics unchanged.
Prefer narrow documentation fixes over implementation changes in this audit story.
drivers: The user requested formal Lattice CLI audit rather than immediate implementation.
The target document is an execution plan, so correctness depends on verifiable commands and safe boundaries.
B-f495 must not interfere with active story B-acec.

options.name: A: Audit-only story with narrow document corrections
pros: Matches the user request for formal audit
Can produce clear findings and evidence quickly
cons: Does not implement the slim / fields prompt changes yet

options.name: B: Combine audit and implementation in one story
pros: Could finish the optimization immediately if audit passes
cons: Expands scope beyond the requested audit
Increases REVIEW risk and could touch prompt mirrors unnecessarily

chosen: A: Audit-only story with narrow document corrections
rationale: Choose the audit-only path because the user asked for formal audit, and implementation should proceed only after the plan is accepted.

preMortem.scenario: The audit edits the plan without proving CLI support.
preMortem.trigger: Relying only on prose claims instead of source and smoke commands.
preMortem.consequence: The plan could look rigorous while containing stale or invalid instructions.
preMortem.mitigation: Cite story-query/checklist handlers and run prompt-token-cost and prompt-registry smokes.

preMortem.trigger: Prompt guidance omits the full-output fallback before evidence-sensitive decisions.
preMortem.consequence: Agents may miss detailed evidence and submit weak conclusions.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the full-output fallback as an acceptance criterion and audit it directly.

preMortem.scenario: The audit story absorbs implementation work.
preMortem.trigger: Fixing templates or CLI behavior while reviewing the document.
preMortem.consequence: Scope expands and may interfere with other active work.
preMortem.mitigation: Limit this story to audit disposition and document corrections only.
